# Erika Ortiz, MSc

### Exploring conflict, governance, and social change through data.

My work brings together political science, international affairs, and data science to examine questions of conflict, peacebuilding, human rights, and governance. I use quantitative and computational methods to explore political and social dynamics, with a particular interest in how evidence can inform research and public policy.
